prompt: Review test/orders.test.js against docs/feature-spec.md and src/orders.js. Write your review to review/test-review.md: list each problem you find, give each one a severity rating, say where it is, and say what to change. Do not change any existing file. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: Names the refund-by-another-customer test as the most serious problem: it catches the error, asserts nothing, and hides that requestRefund never checks the actor.
Reports the missing tests for the shipped-order rejection, non-owner cancel and the pending-approval refund over 500.00, and the missing rounding case for money.
Every finding is true, points to a place in the tests or source, and says what to change. No invented defects.

checks.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("review/test-review.md","utf8");const A=new RegExp("refund by another|requestRefund|empty catch|catch","gi"),R=[new RegExp("no assert|asserts nothing|assertion|swallow|empty catch|never fails|always passes|passes whether|does not assert|not assert|cannot fail","i")],W=500;let ok=false;for(const m of t.matchAll(A)){const s=t.slice(Math.max(0,m.index-W),m.index+m[0].length+W);if(R.every(r=>r.test(s))){ok=true;break}}process.exit(ok?0:1)'
